name: Newberg Public Art Council
description: A volunteer council that commissions and maintains public art (murals, sculptures, the Camellia Trail) throughout Newberg and co-hosts First Friday ARTwalk; formed in 2019 from the merger of the Reverberations Project and the Newberg Downtown Coalition's beautification committee.
registrationNote: Operates under the Newberg Downtown Coalition (contact email is @newbergdowntown.org); no separate IRS registration found for the council itself.
